agent_security.plan_kts:
fun plan() {
  val toolRegistry = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/plan-tools.md")
  val failedRtkContextReads = runCommand(listOf("bash", "-lc", "rtk cat .repo_context/README.md && rtk cat .repo_context/index.md && rtk cat .repo_context/maintenance.md && rtk cat .repo_context/generated/repo_index.md && rtk cat .repo_context/modules/overview/engineering-principles.md"))
  val repoReadme = readRepoFile(".repo_context/README.md")
  val contextIndex = readRepoFile(".repo_context/index.md")
  val maintenance = readRepoFile(".repo_context/maintenance.md")
  val generatedIndex = readRepoFile(".repo_context/generated/repo_index.md")
  val engineeringPrinciples = readRepoFile(".repo_context/modules/overview/engineering-principles.md")
  val testsReproduction = readRepoFile(".repo_context/modules/quality/tests-and-reproduction.md")
  val dimension = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/dimension.txt")
  val rubric = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/rubric.md")
  val pr = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/pr.json")
  val diff = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/pr.diff")
  val taskContext = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
  val evidenceBody = compute(toolRegistry, failedRtkContextReads, repoReadme, contextIndex, maintenance, generatedIndex, engineeringPrinciples, testsReproduction, dimension, rubric, pr, diff, taskContext)
  writeFile("/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", evidenceBody)
  val noopBody = compute(evidenceBody)
  publish("safeoutputs.noop", noopBody)
}
